answer: A new identity serves a probation of 9 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the gale queue naming the bridge that holds the sponsor's bond. Because of that, every alias costs 9 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the signal record exposes exactly who is still on probation. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
